title: <Activity>: hide UI but keep its state

slides.say: Hiding a component with a condition destroys its state. Activity hides it and keeps the state.
Pass mode visible or hidden. When hidden, React hides the children with display none.

slides.text: Hidden: Effects are cleaned up. Visible again: state restored, Effects re-created.
slides.say: While hidden, React destroys their Effects, cleaning up subscriptions. When visible again, the previous state comes back and Effects are re-created.

slides.text: Hidden children still re-render on new props, at lower priority.
slides.say: Hidden children still re-render when props change, just at a lower priority. Think of it as background activity.
